# The shape

PARA routes everything by **actionability**, Zettelkasten governs the notes
within, OKF makes it readable by anyone:

- [PARA containers](/index.md) route by "how actionable is this?" — never by topic
- [Ideas](ideas/one-idea-per-note.md) are atomic: one idea, own words, frontmatter `id` as permanent address
- [Literature Notes](literature/zettel-de-introduction.md) capture sources in passing, feeding Ideas later
- The [Front door](/llms.txt) orients every agent; `log.md` journals every change
- This Structure Note is written curation — distinct from reserved, mechanical `index.md` listings
